• "Burning Hands"

• "Sunburst"

fields.name: Greater Necromancy
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Vampiric Touch"
• "Create Undead"
• "Energy Drain"
( Drain energy from a foe in sight to restore your vitality. )

fields.name: Greater Abjuration
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Shield"
• "Banishment"
• "Invulnerability"
( Invulnerability makes you impervious to deadly perils. )

fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Find Familiar"
• "Dimension Door"
• "Cloud Kill"
( Create a deadly cloud within distance to weaken your foe. )

fields.name: Greater Enchantment
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Suggestion"
• "Dominate Person"

fields.name: Greater Transmutation
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Midas Touch"

fields.name: Lesser Evocation
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Burning Hands"
• "Fireball"
( Wait for your allies to clear the area before hurling a fireball! )

fields.name: Lesser Necromancy
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Vampiric Touch"
• "Create Undead"
( Harm your foe to heal yourself. Raise an undead servant. )

fields.name: Lesser Abjuration
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Shield"
• "Banishment"
( Touch anything to have it banished where you please. )

fields.name: Lesser Conjuration
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Find Familiar"
• "Dimension Door"
( Summon a familiar to assist you. Travel to a faraway place. )

fields.name: Lesser Enchantment
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Suggestion"
• "Dominate Person"
( Turn the dominated person against their own troops. )

fields.name: Lesser Transmutation
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Midas Touch"

fields.name: Elementary Evocation
fields.effect_text:
Cast the "Burning Hands" spell in the spellbook.
( Burn multiple opponents in near vicinity. )

fields.name: Elementary Abjuration
fields.effect_text:
Cast the "Shield" spell in the spellbook.
( The magic shield protects against mundane threats. )

fields.name: Elementary Enchantment
fields.effect_text:
Cast the "Suggestion" spell in the spellbook.
( Compel the opposing champion to take a few extra steps. )

fields.name: Cantrip
fields.effect_text:
Choose and cast one spell in the spellbook —
• "Shocking Grasp" ( To repel a foe! )
• "Magic Missile" ( To blast at range! )
• "Expeditious Retreat" ( To dart a great distance! )

fields.name: Prepare Spells
fields.effect_text:
Add all spell cards to the spellbook. Only Gydion can look at the cards in the spellbook.
As each spell is cast, remove it from the spellbook faceup. The action on the spell card is performed by the hero casting the spell.

fields.name: Shocking Grasp
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: Move the target up to 1 space.

fields.name: Magic Missile
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range and not adjacent to you.

fields.name: Expeditious Retreat
fields.effect_text: Move only in a straight line.

fields.name: Burning Hands
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero adjacent to the target discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Suggestion
fields.effect_text: If able, an enemy hero in radius moves 3 spaces in a straight line.

fields.name: Shield
fields.effect_text: This round: You are immune to basic attacks. (Cancelled if the spell is returned to the spellbook.)

fields.name: Vampiric Touch
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: You may retrieve a discarded card.

fields.name: Fireball
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range, not adjacent to you or to your friendly unit.

fields.name: Create Undead
fields.effect_text: Respawn a friendly minion in an empty friendly spawn point in range in the battle zone.

fields.name: Midas' Touch
fields.effect_text: Gain 1 coin for every two other spell cards removed from the spellbook.

fields.name: Disintegrate
fields.effect_text: Remove a token or an enemy non-heavy minion adjacent to you.

fields.name: Dominate Person
fields.effect_text: Target an enemy hero in radius. Defeat an enemy minion in radius adjacent to the target.

fields.name: Find Familiar
fields.effect_text: Place a :familiar_token: Familiar token in radius. You may remove up to three other spell cards from the spellbook faceup.

fields.name: Dimension Door
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space at maximum radius. +1 Radius for each other spell card removed from the spellbook.

fields.name: Banishment
fields.effect_text: Place a unit or a token adjacent to you into a space in radius.

fields.name: Sunburst
fields.effect_text: Target a unit at maximum range. +1 :attack: Attack and +1 Range for each other spell card removed from the spellbook.

fields.name: Energy Drain
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in range discards a non-basic card, if able. Your team regains 1 spent :life_counter: Life counter.

fields.name: Cloud Kill
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius discards a basic card, if able.

fields.name: Invulnerability
fields.effect_text: This Round: You are immune to non-basic attacks.

fields.name: Power Word Kill
fields.effect_text: Defeat an enemy hero in radius with no cards in hand.

fields.name: Polymorph
fields.effect_text: Swap an enemy hero in radius with a token in radius or with an enemy minion in radius.

fields.name: Wish
fields.effect_text: Cast any spell in the Spellbook. After you cast the "Wish" spell three times your team wins the game.

fields.name: The Archwizard
fields.effect_text: Whenever you would add cards to the spellbook, you may cast the "Wish" spell in the spellbook instead.

fields.name: Drop Trooper
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in a straight line in radius. Push up to two enemy units adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Mobile Scout
fields.effect_text: End of turn: Place yourself into a space in radius not in a straight line from you. You may then fast travel, if able.

fields.name: Killing Ground
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius who is not adjacent to terrain discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Hunting Season
fields.effect_text:
Move up to two enemy minions in radius, up to 3 spaces each, to spaces in radius.
Next turn: The first two times an enemy minion in radius is defeated, gain 1 coin.

fields.name: Killshot
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range, in a straight line, and not adjacent to you.

fields.name: Super-Shotgun
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. Before the attack: An enemy hero adjacent to the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Assault Jump
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in a straight line in radius. Push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Delayed Jump
fields.effect_text: End of turn: Place yourself into a space in radius not in a straight line from you.

fields.name: Pin Down
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius who is not adjacent to terrain discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Mark for Death
fields.effect_text:
Move an enemy minion in radius up to 3 spaces to a space in radius.
Next turn: The first time an enemy minion in radius is defeated, gain 1 coin.

fields.name: Prepared Shot
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range, in a straight line, and not adjacent to you.

fields.name: Shotgun
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. Before the attack: An enemy hero adjacent to the target discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Steam Jump
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in a straight line in radius. Push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 1 space.

fields.name: Suppress
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero in radius who is not adjacent to terrain discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Snipe
fields.effect_text: Target a unit at maximum range, and in a straight line.

fields.name: Bounce
fields.effect_text: Move 2 spaces in a straight line, ignoring obstacles; if this card is already resolved as you perform this action, may repeat once.

fields.name: Reload!
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Perform the primary action of your rightmost resolved card.
• Defeat a minion adjacent to you.

fields.name: Bullet Time
fields.effect_text: After you resolve a basic card, you may perform the primary action on that card; you cannot target the same enemy hero twice in the same turn this way.

fields.name: Throwing Spear
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• You may discard a card. If you have a card in the discard, target a unit in range.

fields.name: Furious Charge
fields.effect_text: Before the attack: Move 2, 3, or 4 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.

fields.name: Master Skald
fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in range gains 2 coins; if any hero was defeated this round, that friendly hero gains 4 coins instead.

fields.name: Fortify
fields.effect_text: This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a basic card. If you do, the minion is not removed.

fields.name: Counterattack
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero adjacent to you who has played an attack card this turn discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Savage Kick
fields.effect_text: Move up to 2 spaces. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Throwing Axe
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• You may discard a card; if you do, target a unit in range.

fields.name: Bullrush
fields.effect_text: Before the attack: Move 2 or 3 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.

fields.name: War Drummer
fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in range gains 1 coin; if any hero was defeated this round, that friendly hero gains 3 coins instead.

fields.name: Bolster
fields.effect_text: This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a silver card. If you do, the minion is not removed.

fields.name: Shield Bash
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero adjacent to you who has played an attack card this turn discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Mighty Punch
fields.effect_text: You may move 1 space. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Bulwark
fields.effect_text:
You may retrieve a discarded card.
This turn: You and friendly units in radius cannot be moved, pushed, swapped or placed by enemy heroes.

fields.name: Onslaught
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: Move into the space it occupied, if able.

fields.name: Shield
fields.effect_text:
This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a silver card. If you do, the minion is not removed.
(The enemy hero still gains the coins for defeating the minion.)

fields.name: Brutal Jab
fields.effect_text: You may move 1 space. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 1 space.

fields.name: Mad Dash
fields.effect_text:
Before the attack: Move 2 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.
(If you cannot make this move, you cannot attack.)

fields.name: One Man Army
fields.effect_text: During minion battle you count as a heavy minion; if you would be removed, lose the push instead.

fields.name: Safe Travels
fields.effect_text:
Swap with an enemy hero in radius.
This turn: That hero is immune.
End of turn: Swap with that hero, regardless of radius and immunity. You may move 1 space.

fields.name: That Way!
fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in radius chooses a distance of 1, 2 or 3; move both of you that number of spaces in the same direction of your choice.

fields.name: See Nothing
fields.effect_text:
Swap with an enemy hero in radius.
You may move 1 space.

fields.name: Monkey Business
fields.effect_text:
Swap two friendly units in radius.
You may move 1 space.

fields.name: Trusted Sidekick
fields.effect_text:
Choose one, or both, in any order —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a hero in range, adjacent to your friendly hero and not adjacent to you.

fields.name: Pile On
fields.effect_text:
Choose one, or both, in any order —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a minion in range, adjacent to your friendly hero.

fields.name: There and Back Again
fields.effect_text:
Swap with an enemy hero in radius.
This turn: That hero is immune.
End of turn: Swap with that hero, regardless of radius and immunity.

fields.name: This Way!
fields.effect_text:
A friendly hero in radius chooses a distance of 1 or 2; move both of you that number of spaces in the same direction of your choice.
( Both must be moved the full distance, or neither one moves. )

fields.name: Monkey Twist
fields.effect_text: Swap two friendly units in radius.

fields.name: Hear Nothing
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy hero in radius.

fields.name: Even the Odds
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a hero in range, adjacent to your friendly hero.

fields.name: Outnumber
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a minion in range, adjacent to your friendly hero.

fields.name: Unexpected Journey
fields.effect_text:
Swap with an enemy hero in radius.
This turn: That hero is immune.
End of turn: Swap with that hero, regardless of radius and immunity.

fields.name: Monkey Trick
fields.effect_text: Swap two friendly units in radius.

fields.name: Helping Hand
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• Target a hero in range, adjacent to your friendly hero.

fields.name: Hurry Up!
fields.effect_text:
Set the printed :initiative: Initiative value of an unresolved card of a hero in range to 11, until it is resolved, or otherwise changes state.
( This may change the initiative order and tie breakers. )

fields.name: Fight and Flight
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. If the target is not defeated, After the attack: If able, move 3 spaces in a straight line.

fields.name: The Ultimate Trick
fields.effect_text: You choose the next action, and how it is performed, for a hero you target with the "Hurry Up!".
